definition.name: column-hilbert-inner-product-displays
definition.definition: Byte-matched from refs/kitaev-2405.02434/approximate_algebras.tex, DEFINITIONAL displays only. Level one (tex:1125-1132, lem_PQ_Hilb): Y^\dag\cdot X=\braket{Y}{X}\,\wt{Q} (X,Y in S_{P,Q}), where Y^\dag\cdot X=\Co_{Q}(Y^{\dag}X) and \wt{Q}=\Co_Q(Q); and |\braket{X}{X}-||X||^2| <= O(\delta+\eps)||X||^2. Extended (tex:1547-1549, display 1dQ_ip_ext): Y^\dag\cdot X=\braket{Y}{X}\,\wt{Q} (X,Y in M_{n,1} tensor S_{P,Q}) where \braket{Y}{X}=\sum_l \braket{[Y]_{l1}}{[X]_{l1}} — the amplified coordinate-sum normalization. LOUD EXCLUSION: the adjacent display 1dQ_ip_norm_ext (tex:1551-1554) is the KNOWN FALSE unsquared norm claim and is NOT provisioned — its corrected squared form is exactly the registry target lem-hcb-column-hilbert-squared and must be proved, not cited.
